science.title: Chemists discover and isolate a new boron-oxygen molecule
science.description: Oxygen is a cornerstone of chemistry, largely because it is so good at building the organic molecules that make up our world. Some oxygen-based compounds called peroxides are famous for being highly reactive—they act like oxygen delivery trucks, transferring atoms to other molecules. This process is essential for everything from creating new medicines to industrial manufacturing.

ai.title: IKS Health Announces Acquisition of ARAI Solutions, an AI Management and Technology Company
ai.description: IKS Health, the healthcare brand of Inventurus Knowledge Solutions Limited, announced the acquisition of ARAI Solutions on May 13, 2026, to accelerate full agentic AI technology stack development. ARAI's biomedical knowledge graphs and ontology add a critical knowledge layer to IKS Health's existing four-layer healthcare AI stack. The integration is expected to reduce dependency on third-party AI infrastructure across areas including autonomous coding, clinical decisions, denial prevention, prior authorization reasoning, and precision medicine. ARAI's explainable AI approach, described as converting black box AI into glass box AI, is positioned to deliver transparent and traceable outputs for regulators and healthcare organisations.

ai.title: The Latest: Trump in China for Xi meeting to focus on Iran war, trade and US arms sales to Taiwan
ai.description: U.S. President Donald Trump has arrived in Beijing for his highly anticipated summit with Chinese leader Xi Jinping at a restless moment for a world worried about war, trade and artificial intelligence. The visit occurs at a delicate moment for Trump’s presidency, as his popularity at home has been weighed down by the U.S. and Israel’s war with Iran and rising inflation as a consequence of that conflict. The president is seeking a win by signing deals with China to buy more American food and aircraft, saying he’ll be talking with Xi about trade “more than anything else.”
